## Serpentine Sniper (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
Nagaji slayer 12  
CE Medium humanoid (reptilian)  
**Init** +1; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +17  


**Defense**


**AC** 22, touch 17 (+1 dodge, 23 vs. beams and rays), flat-footed 16 (+2 armor [+7 vs. beams and rays], +1 deflection, +5 Dex, +1 natural, +2 shield)  
**hp** 156 (12d10+36)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +13, **Will** +7; +2 vs. mind-affecting and poison  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** mwk kukri +13/+8/+3 (1d4/18-20)  
**Ranged** +1 zero rifle +19/+14/+9 (2d6+1 cold)  
**Special Attacks** slayer talents (assassinate [DC 16], deadly range, evasion, ranger combat style [archery x2], rogue talent [superior sniper]), sneak attack +4d6, studied target (+3, move or swift action, 3 targets)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 21, **Con** 14, **Int** 10, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +12; **CMD** 28  
**Feats** Expert Sniper, Improved Precise Shot, Improved Vital Strike, Master Sniper, , Rapid Shot, Skill Focus (Stealth), Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (zero rifle), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Deadly Aim](../../rules/feats/deadly-aim.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Deadly Aim needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +15, Climb +10, Handle Animal +6 (+8 with reptiles), Knowledge (nature) +10, Perception +17, Stealth +21, Survival +15, Swim +12  
**Languages** Common, Draconic  
**SQ** stalker, swift tracker, track +6  
**Combat Gear** +1 zero rifle with extra charge pack, masterwork kukri; potion of cure moderate wounds, potion of haste; **Other Gear** +2 belt of incredible dexterity, +1 red scatterlight suit, +1 buckler, ring of protection +1, +1 cloak of resistance, 90 gp
